### A Healthy Body
Author: Charles Stanley
Site: In Touch Ministries
URL: https://www.intouch.org/read/daily-devotions/a-healthy-body
Passage: 1 Corinthians 6:19-20
Points:
- God values our physical beings and never intended physical and spiritual life to be separated.
- Believers cannot excuse immoral conduct by pretending bodily actions do not affect spiritual standing.
- The Holy Spirit resides inside every Christian, turning our bodies into His dwelling place.
- Physical health and behavior serve as visible testimonies of our walk with Christ.

### Keeping God’s Temple Clean
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-november-24-2023.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 6:19-20
Points:
- God's true sanctuary is no longer a physical building, but the believer.
- People often respect church facilities while dishonoring God with their conduct outside church walls.
- Because the Holy Spirit lives inside us, our bodies must remain holy at all times.
- Believers are called to honor God both publicly and when nobody else is looking.
